facts.business: Kriti Nutrients Limited is a leading Indian soybean processing company that manufactures branded refined edible oils (soybean, mustard, sunflower, groundnut) and value-added soybean derivatives and protein ingredients for food processing, pharmaceutical, dairy, aquaculture, and poultry industries.

segments.name: Value-added Soybean Derivatives and Protein Products

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matters: 1) Provisions and Contingent liabilities in respect of certain litigations of Assessment of Direct and Indirect Taxes and related to leasehold land of factory building not acknowledged as debt. 2) Assessment of Carrying Value of Investment in Associate (Kriti Industries (India) Limited) of ₹5,151.87 Lakh carried at cost.

key_risks: Persistent fluctuations in edible oil markets
Input cost volatility compressing product spreads
Material uncertain tax positions including disputes on Direct and Indirect Taxes and leasehold land
Impairment risk on investment in associate (Kriti Industries (India) Limited) due to estimation uncertainty in recoverable amount
facts.related_party_note: Investment in associate Kriti Industries (India) Limited of ₹5,151.87 Lakh as at 31 March 2026; part of Kriti Group alongside Kriti Industries (India) Limited.
